# Results — Study 734 (NBA-Finals-Effect)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test — **the
losing team's home-city market dips (and the champion's pops) around the NBA Finals** — the
Edmans-García-Norli (2007) sports-sentiment "elimination shock", applied to basketball's
biggest night instead of the soccer World Cup. Offline & deterministic once cached; run
`python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every number. As-of **2026-06-30** (the last
complete calendar month). Fingerprint `e68e0ed8bc79` (17 metro proxies + the `SPY` US
benchmark, one combined panel).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily adjusted (total-return) closes, 17 single-stock/ETF metro proxies + `SPY` (S&P 500 total-return), one combined panel: 7,166 rows, 1998-01-02 → 2026-06-30 |
| Calendar | **hardcoded**: 26 NBA Finals 2000→2025, all contested and decided, champion + runner-up + exact series-clinching game date (Basketball-Reference / NBA.com, cross-checked per year against Wikipedia). 2020 clinched in the Orlando "bubble" in **October**; 2021 was COVID-delayed into **July** — both named quirks, neither a cancellation |
| Events resolvable | **52 of 52** possible role-events (26 Finals × {loser, champion}) resolve — **26 loser**, **26 champion**. Every metro proxy predates its earliest event, so the funnel is *not* a coverage story; the structural limit is that **all but one Finals is USA-vs-USA on a single shared tape** |
| The "civic proxy" (labelled) | No US city has a stock index, so each metro is a single, **real, tradable, deliberately-coarse** hometown large-cap: Lakers→`DIS`, Celtics→`STT`, Warriors→`WFC`, Spurs→`CFR`, Cavaliers→`KEY`, Heat→`CCL`, Pistons→`F`, Mavericks→`T`, Pacers→`LLY`, 76ers→`CMCSA`, Nets→`PEG`, Magic→`DRI`, Thunder→`DVN`, Bucks→`ROK`, Suns→`RSG`, Nuggets→`DVA`; Raptors→`EWC` (the one genuinely separate national market, Canada). A single stock's return is a **noisy** stand-in for civic mood — the caveat travels with every number |
| Statistics | one-sample *t* of the abnormal return across independent, non-overlapping yearly events (the correct unit — not a daily panel); Wilson hit-rate interval; a 20-seed × 200-draw random-window placebo per cut; Welch *t* for the champion-vs-loser third axis |
| Execution / costs | one documented convention: the clinching game tips ~9pm and ends ~11:30pm local — after the close on the game date. **day(-1)** = last close on/before the game date (does not know the result; five hours before tip-off for a weekday game); **day(0)** = first close after (fully public). Signal = day(-1)→day(-1)+k; Tradability = day(0)→day(0)+k, net of 2× one-way cost × NAV |
| Horizons | k = 1 (next trading day — the EGN elimination-shock horizon) and k = 5 (~1 week) |

**Selection / interpretation, named on the Signal axis:** the proxy is the load-bearing
caveat. A hometown large-cap is a real instrument you could trade, but its day-to-day return
is dominated by *its own business*, not civic mood — so even a genuine "home-market
sentiment" pulse would be buried in company-specific noise. This is disclosed, not patched:
the null we report is consistent both with "no effect exists" and with "an effect exists but
is far below the noise of a single-stock proxy." A cleaner test would need a true city index,
which does not exist.

## The signal — abnormal return, day(-1) → day(-1)+k (metro proxy − SPY)

| cut | n | mean AR | *t* | hit rate (predicted sign, Wilson 95%) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| loser, next day (k=1) — *EGN predicts negative* | 26 | −0.149% | −0.47 | neg 13/26 = 50.0% [32.1%, 67.9%] |
| loser, 1 week (k=5) | 26 | +0.020% | +0.03 | neg 15/26 = 57.7% [38.9%, 74.5%] |
| champion, next day — *folklore predicts positive* | 26 | −0.354% | −1.22 | pos 10/26 = 38.5% [22.4%, 57.5%] |
| champion, 1 week | 26 | −0.586% | −1.13 | pos 12/26 = 46.2% [28.8%, 64.5%] |
| combined, next day | 52 | −0.252% | −1.18 | 23/52 = 44.2% [31.6%, 57.7%] |
| combined, 1 week | 52 | −0.283% | −0.68 | 23/52 = 44.2% [31.6%, 57.7%] |

**Not one of six cuts clears the desk's |*t*| ≥ 2 bar.** The EGN loser dip is a whisper
(−0.149%, *t* = −0.47) that has vanished by one week (+0.020%). The champion "feel-good pop"
runs the *wrong way* (−0.354%, *t* = −1.22): the winning city's proxy, if anything, slightly
*under*performs the market — the opposite of the folklore. The loser's next-day hit rate is
exactly 50.0% — a coin flip.

## The broad-market cross-check — does the whole US tape move?

EGN's mechanism requires the two competitors to sit in *different* stock markets. The NBA
Finals is (2019 aside) USA-vs-USA, so any net national-mood shock cancels — one US city
elated, one deflated, both trading `SPY`.

| test | n | mean | *t* |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| SPY market-model abnormal return, day(0) | 26 | +0.139% | +0.81 |

`SPY`'s day-after move is statistically indistinguishable from zero (+0.139%, *t* = +0.81) —
exactly the within-country cancellation the mechanism predicts. There is no market-wide
Finals effect to find, by design.

## Random-window placebo (20 seeds × 200 draws per event)

For each event, redraw a random (non-Finals) k-session window on the SAME proxy's own
history and recompute the abnormal return; compare the observed mean to that null cloud.

| cut | tail | observed | placebo mean (sd) | *p* |
|---|---|--:|--:|--:|
| loser, next day | left (predict dip) | −0.149% | +0.015% (0.389%) | 0.325 |
| loser, 1 week | left | +0.020% | +0.012% (…) | 0.491 |
| champion, next day | right (predict pop) | −0.354% | +0.011% (…) | 0.852 |
| combined, next day | left | −0.252% | +0.014% (…) | 0.143 |

Every cut sits comfortably *inside* the luck cloud. The loser's −0.149% next-day dip is the
kind of number a random month produces one time in three (*p* = 0.325); the champion's
wrong-signed −0.354% is nowhere near the positive tail its folklore predicts (*p* = 0.852).

## Robustness — jackknife on the "most negative" cut (champion, next day)

Leave-one-out on the 26 champion/next-day events: full-sample *t* = **−1.223**; jackknife
range **[−1.571, −0.714]** — every single leave-one-out draw stays well short of the |*t*| = 2
bar. There is no lucky year propping up (or masking) a signal; the whole thing is flat.

## Event anatomy — mean cumulative abnormal return by trading day (day(-1) anchor)

| day | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 5 |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| loser | 0.000% | −0.149% | −0.363% | −0.217% | +0.020% |
| champion | 0.000% | −0.354% | −0.347% | −0.308% | −0.586% |

Both paths just wander around zero within ±0.6% — no clean day-1 spike that reverts (the
signature of a real one-day sentiment shock, the way EGN's soccer dip lands and holds), no
sustained drift. Noise.

## Tradability — capture, day(0) → day(0)+k, net of costs

Entered at day(0)'s close (the first price *after* the result is public — zero look-ahead),
held k sessions. The announcement's un-tradable overnight jump, day(-1)→day(0), is excluded.

| cut | gross | net @ 5 bps (*t*) | net @ 10 bps (*t*) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| loser, next day | −0.220% (*t* = −0.69) | −0.320% (−1.00) | −0.420% (−1.31) |
| loser, 1 week | +0.372% (*t* = +0.90) | +0.272% (+0.66) | +0.172% (+0.42) |
| champion, next day | +0.003% (*t* = +0.01) | −0.097% (−0.38) | −0.197% (−0.77) |
| champion, 1 week | −0.859% (*t* = −1.61) | −0.959% (−1.80) | −1.059% (**−1.99**) |
| combined, next day | −0.109% (*t* = −0.53) | −0.209% (−1.02) | −0.309% (−1.51) |
| combined, 1 week | −0.244% (*t* = −0.71) | −0.344% (−1.00) | −0.444% (−1.29) |

The single cut that grazes the bar — champion/1-week net @ 10 bps, *t* = −1.99 — is (a) still
short of |*t*| ≥ 2, (b) pointing the *wrong* way for the folklore (the champion city
*losing*, not popping), and (c) not placebo-confirmed: observed −0.959% vs placebo mean
−0.062% (sd 0.786%) → **p = 0.115**. No cut clears |*t*| ≥ 2 net of costs with placebo
support. Tradability = **Mirage**.

## Third axis — champion vs loser: does the winning city beat the losing city?

Welch *t* of the champion's abnormal return minus the loser's, same event set:

| horizon | champion mean | loser mean | Welch *t* (champion − loser) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| signal, next day | −0.354% | −0.149% | **−0.48** |
| signal, 1 week | −0.586% | +0.020% | **−0.72** |

The differential is not merely insignificant — it runs *backwards*: the champion city's proxy
does slightly *worse* than the loser city's at both horizons. Whatever tiny wiggles exist,
they do not line up with "winning is good for your city's market, losing is bad." The
folklore's core ordering is **not supported** — the loser's city does not measurably dip, and
the champion's city does not pop.

## Synthetic positive control — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic paired (proxy, benchmark) log-return world (ρ ≈ 0.55, like a single large-cap
vs the S&P 500, with the proxy carrying extra idiosyncratic vol) with a scheduled synthetic
event calendar and a TUNABLE planted "loser dip" landing the day after each (night-game)
event; no network.

| world | one-sample *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (bump = 0), **20 seeds** | mean **−0.12** (sd 0.88), **\|t\| ≥ 2 in 0/20 seeds** |
| planted dip = −1.0% (seed 734) | **−2.15** |
| planted dip = −2.0% (seed 734) | **−5.42** |

The detector recovers a planted dip cleanly and never fires on the null (0/20 seeds) — the
machinery works and is unbiased; the real-tape story is genuinely this flat. *(A
faithful-engine / power check only — never cited in support of the real-tape stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — NONE.** No cut of six (loser/champion × next-day/week) clears |*t*| ≥ 2. The EGN
  loser dip is a placebo-consistent whisper (−0.149%, *t* = −0.47, *p* = 0.325) that reverts
  within a week; the champion "feel-good pop" runs the wrong way (−0.354%, *t* = −1.22); the
  broad-market check is a flat +0.139% (*t* = +0.81) — exactly the cancellation EGN's
  within-country mechanism predicts. A single hometown stock is too noisy a civic-mood proxy
  to certify anything, and nothing here asks us to.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** No net-of-cost, zero-look-ahead capture clears |*t*| ≥ 2. The one
  cut that grazes it (champion/1-week net @ 10 bps, *t* = −1.99) is wrong-signed for the
  folklore and evaporates under its own placebo (*p* = 0.115).
- **Does the loser's city dip? — BUSTED.** 26 Finals, 2000→2025, a proper event study, a
  random-window placebo, a jackknife and a champion-vs-loser contrast all agree: no
  detectable home-market dip for the loser, no pop for the champion (if anything, backwards),
  and the whole cross-country design collapses because both teams share one US tape.
